title: Add new playable-model re-freeze gates to the SRD audit
notes:
Implemented: packages/core/src/rules/srdPlayabilityAudit.ts (auditSrdPlayability) + tests, exported via internal.ts. 5 gates: untyped-progression-marker (RED 47 ->.2), null-spellcasting-value (RED Ranger L1 ->.2), missing-class-feature-record (RED Thieves' Cant ->.3), overlay-dependence (RED 47 ->.5), proficiency-note-bleed (GREEN guard ->.6). Per-gate fixture pairs + committed-pack RED baselines + it.fails re-freeze-readiness ratchet. No frozen path touched -> no thaw note. PR #352. verify:worktree green (2843 passed, 1 expected-fail). Table-link (.8) and choice-coverage (.9) gates deferred to those beads. Close when #352 merges.
PR #352 review addressed (commit 7881121): overlay-dependence starting-equipment gate now requires the existing overlay shape (startingEquipment.entries[] of typed {kind:'choice',options[],sourceText}|{kind:'fixed',text,sourceText}), NOT a root choices/fixed shape. Frozen pack already has startingEquipment.entries but as PROSE STRINGS; gate stays RED (12 classes) and goes green when .5 converts them in place. verify:worktree green (2843 passed).
Landed on main: PR #352 merged (merge 0676b2b). CodeQL ReDoS fixed in-PR. Branch+worktree cleaned. Closing.
